parsed_json.sql: SELECT a.activity_id, ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_type, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.tid = 165 AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' ORDER BY a.activity_id, ass.chembl_id, md.chembl_id
